name: get_file_by_path
description: Returns the full source code of a file by its exact path.

path.description: The exact file path to retrieve, e.g., '/src/main/java/com/example/MyClass.java'

name: get_class_source
description: Returns the full source code of a class by name.

class_name.description: The name of the class to retrieve, e.g., 'Color'.

name: list_files_in_package
description: Returns a list of file paths in the given package.

name: search_symbol
description: Returns all files containing the specified symbol.

symbol.description: Symbol name to search for, e.g., 'Color'.
